_doc: Probe eligibility: did this EXACT utterance reach the ask path, under which tree? Enforced by scripts/probe_eligibility.assert_eligible and tests/test_probe_eligibility_is_enforced.py.
_rule: Eligible = the exact utterance was observed reaching the behaviour under test under a matching pinned config and CODE sha. Failed eligibility is FATAL to the arm, never recorded as '0 asks observed'. The sha is scoped to behaviour-relevant code because registering eligibility is itself a commit - comparing whole-repo SHAs made the guard invalidate its own evidence.
